name: sled
title: The sled: pushed by the bow, it pushes the disc
orientation: Flat on the bed on its plate, the tab standing up. In the launcher it stands on edge in the barrel slot: the plate under the magazine, the rod back through the grip's top, the tab hanging down through the floor to the bow's tip, the ring out of the back.

thickness.rule: The plate: the slot's height less a fit, so it slides

length.rule: The plate along the barrel: it blocks the magazine's mouth at rest and is guided by the slot's walls

nose.rule: The nose past the plate's front edge: the only part that touches the disc

nose_width.rule: The nose's reach across the slot from the bed wall: its middle is spin_offset off the disc's centre, so the push spins the disc

wall.rule: The body's bed wall: the plate starts a fit above it

width.rule: The bow's width: the tab sits at its middle

across.rule: The plate across the slot: the disc's diameter, a fit off the bed wall and the lid

tab.rule: The tab along the barrel: its rear face is what the bow pushes, its front what the sear's tooth would catch if it reached

tab_width.rule: The tab across, through its slit in the floor

tab_drop.rule: How far the tab hangs below the floor's underside: room for the bow's tip to press it, with the tip's drop as it bends

rod.rule: From the tab's rear face back to the cocking ring's centre: the ring sits against the grip's back wall at rest

rod_width.rule: The rod across the slot: it rides the floor either side of the tab's gap, and carries the plate

ring.rule: The cocking ring's outer radius: a finger goes through

rod_z.rule: The rod's near edge across the slot: beside the tab, clear of the sear's tooth, which rises on the bed side

ring_z.rule: The ring's centre across the slot: its rim a fit under the lid

reach.rule: The plate ahead of the tab: the tab hangs into the grip, where the bow is, and the plate runs under the magazine

overlap.rule: How far the rod sinks into the plate, so they join
